education.about_default: Private school or college in {city}. Parents ask about fees due, timings and admissions; new families enquire about seats and visits.

questions.ask: The student's name and class, or the class they want admission in
Whether they need fee status, timings or an admission visit
For admissions, a day to visit the campus

education.warm_when: A new family wants to visit or apply, or a parent confirms a payment.
education.unqualified_when: The person is selling something or job-hunting.
education.demo_hint: The demo has one sample record: Ayesha Khan, Class 6-B, September fee pending, due 10 October. Use it only if the parent names her or asks generally about their child's fee in this demo. For any other student, say the office will confirm. Admissions: offer a campus visit slot within opening hours. Never state fee amounts.

real-estate.about_default: Property agency or developer in {city}. Buyers, many of them overseas Pakistanis, ask about plots, houses and apartments, budgets, societies and site visits.

questions.ask: Their budget, in crore or lakh
Which society, sector or area they prefer
Plot or unit size (marla, kanal or square feet) and type
Whether they are in Pakistan or overseas

real-estate.warm_when: The buyer has shared budget, area and size and wants a site visit or a call within the next 3 months.
real-estate.unqualified_when: The person is selling a service, job-hunting or only wants to rent out a room.
real-estate.demo_hint: Qualify budget, society or area, size, timeline and whether the buyer is overseas, one question at a time. Stored sample listings and site-visit slots are handled by a separate property service; never state a price, payment plan or availability yourself. Legal, NOC, transfer, possession and tax questions go to an agent.

missed_label.en: Property leads a week that get a slow or no reply
missed_label.ur: ہر ہفتے وہ لیڈز جنہیں دیر سے یا کوئی جواب نہیں ملتا

recover_label.en: Share of those leads that would close (%)
recover_label.ur: ان لیڈز میں سے سودا بننے کا حصہ (%)

formula.en: Formula: leads a week × 4.3 × average commission × share that closes. Payback: setup ÷ (monthly won back − monthly fee).
formula.ur: فارمولا: ہفتہ وار لیڈز × 4.3 × اوسط کمیشن × سودا بننے کا حصہ۔ واپسی: سیٹ اپ ÷ (ماہانہ واپسی − ماہانہ فیس)۔
